title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: Learn how TaraHive collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information.

blocks.text: At TaraHive, we value your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the measures we take to protect your personal data when you use our services.

items: Account information such as your name, email address, and profile details.
Travel-related information including itineraries, destinations, budgets, and notes.
Location information when you grant permission for maps, weather, or SOS features.
Device and usage information to improve performance and troubleshoot issues.
Enable collaboration with users you invite.
Deliver weather updates and emergency-related features.
Improve the reliability, security, and performance of the application.

blocks.text: We do not sell your personal information. Information is shared only with your authorized collaborators, trusted service providers required to operate TaraHive, or when required by applicable law.
We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
Although we strive to protect your information, no method of electronic storage or internet transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

items: Update or correct your account information.
Delete your account, subject to applicable legal obligations.
Withdraw permissions such as location access through your device settings.

blocks.text: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. Any changes will become effective once the updated version is published within TaraHive.
